# IEC district report fixtures

Unmodified public Excel downloads checked on 7 November 2026:

- `garden-route-2026.xls`: https://results.elections.org.za/home/LGEPublicReports/1887/Detailed%20Results/WP/DC4.xls
- `sedibeng-2026.xls`: https://results.elections.org.za/home/LGEPublicReports/1887/Detailed%20Results/GP/DC42.xls

These are district 40% ballot reports, not full district council seat allocations.
Garden Route has 228,399 valid votes and 2,631 spoilt votes. Sedibeng has
193,531 valid votes and 2,344 spoilt votes in this captured version. Subsequent
versions of the public URLs can change while counting continues.
